name: 高斯光束束腰半径计算器

map.由波长、聚焦透镜焦距与入射光束直径，按 w₀ = 4λf/(πD) 计算束腰半径: From the wavelength, the focal length of the focusing lens and the incident beam diameter, compute the beam waist radius using w₀ = 4λf/(πD).
map.📖 查看「聚焦高斯光束腰斑 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Focused Gaussian Beam Waist User Guide"
map.w₀ = 4λf/(πD) 计算束腰半径: w₀ = 4λf/(πD) to compute the beam waist radius
map.适用于入射为准直高斯光束、透镜口径远大于光束的近似。: Applicable to the approximation of a collimated incident Gaussian beam with a lens aperture much larger than the beam.
map.束腰半径越小，聚焦功率密度越高。: The smaller the beam waist radius, the higher the focused power density.
map.由波长与束腰算远场发散与腰斑。: From the wavelength and beam waist, compute the far-field divergence and waist.
map.M² 因子修正实际光束。: Use the M² factor to correct for real beams.
map.1064nm 激光束腰 w0=1mm → 远场半角 θ=λ/(πw0)=1.06: A 1064nm laser with beam waist w0=1mm → far-field half-angle θ=λ/(πw0)=1.064e-3/(π×1)≈0.339mrad; at 1m the spot radius is ≈0.34mm.
map.同束经 f=50mm 透镜聚焦，焦点腰 w0'≈λf/(πw)=1.064e-3: Focusing the same beam through an f=50mm lens gives a focal waist w0'≈λf/(πw)=1.064e-3×50/(π×1)≈16.9μm, used for precision micromachining.
map.高斯腰斑最小？: How small can the Gaussian waist be?
map.受衍射极限，波长越短、入射腰越大聚焦越小；M²>1 的实际光束比理想大 M² 倍: Limited by the diffraction limit: a shorter wavelength and a larger incident waist give a smaller focus; a real beam with M²>1 is M² times larger than ideal.
map.θ=λ/(πw0)，腰越小发散越大，准直需大腰或长焦距扩束。: θ=λ/(πw0); a smaller waist gives larger divergence, so collimation needs a large waist or a long-focal-length beam expander.
